name: 12-sai. ~Koi Suru Diary~
source:
☆This is the story of Hanabi and Yui's seven special days☆

Your feelings push the story forward. What will tomorrow look like...?

Hanabi's side ~Sparkling Days~

Seven days for feelings to bloom on a stage!

Hanabi and the others were chosen to put on a school play.
There's a lot going on, as Yuzuki, Inaba and everyone else from Aoba Elementary
is practicing for the play.
This is the story of these seven days, with many bonds yet to be established!

Yui's side ~Heart-throbbing Days~

First visits, first meetings.
Love and friendship will thrive during these seven days!

Yui and her friends go to a kids' camp.
There, she meets Takechi and Kokona, who looks exactly like Kokoa.
This is the story of these emotionally-charged seven days!

[translated from [url=http://age12diary.happinet-games.com]the official website[/url]]
translation:
☆這是花日與結衣的特別七日故事☆

你的感情推動故事前進。明天會是什麼樣子……？

花日篇～閃耀的日子～

讓感情在舞臺上綻放的7天！

花日和夥伴們被選中出演學校話劇。
為了排練話劇，柚希、稻葉與青葉小學的其他人都忙得不可開交。
這是屬於這7天的故事，許多羈絆即將在此建立！

結衣篇～心跳的日子～

第一次造訪，第一次相遇。
愛情與友情將在這7天裡蓬勃發展！

結衣和朋友們前往兒童夏令營。
在那裡，她遇見了武智，以及長得和心愛一模一樣的可可娜。
這是屬於這段情感激盪的7天的故事！

[譯自[url=http://age12diary.happinet-games.com]官方網站[/url]]
